Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.DarkEnabled: Dark climate at night and in fog
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.DarkEnabled_too: Darkens, desaturates and tints the world at night and in the fog.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.DarkIntensity_t: 0 disables the effect, 1 is default, 2 is double.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.FogEventEveryDa: Fog is an event: it rolls in at any hour, announced by a siren 30 seconds before. On average once every this many in-game days (each gap is rolled between half and one and a half times this, counted from the end of the last one). Outside the event there is no fog at all.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.FogMaxHours_too: Longest fog, in in-game hours. Each fog lasts a random value between the minimum and the maximum.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.FogEscalation: Fog: tension that grows with the days
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.FogEscalation_t: The fog starts rarer and gets more frequent as the save ages: at first the average interval is one and a half times the setting, it drops to the setting by day 30 and to three quarters of it from day 45 on. The red fog chance stays the same until day 30 and climbs to double by day 90. Off, the sandbox numbers hold for the whole game.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.RedFogEnabled_t: Sometimes the fog comes red: a lower, harsher siren warns, the fog turns red (the light too, with the dark climate on) and every zombie inside it is a monster, split evenly among the enabled types (Clicker, Runner, Faceless, Mourner); a disabled type's share stays normal. Echoes stay Echoes.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.RedFogChance_to: Percentage of fogs that come red. Rolled once per fog, at the siren: saving and loading does not change it. No fog comes red during the grace days; with growing tension on, the chance climbs from day 30 to double by day 90.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.RedFogGraceDays: For this many days at the start of the save no fog comes red. 0 turns the grace period off.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.EcoEnabled_tool: Bodies near players release Echoes at night, once per body, but only bodies that died before dusk: whoever dies at night waits for the next one. Burn or bury the dead. An Echo's bite infects like any zombie's.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.EcoMaxPerPlayer: How many Echoes can be alive near each player at the same time.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.EcoRadius_toolt: Distance from the player within which a body can release an Echo.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.NightFaster_too: At night every zombie moves faster (see the multiplier).
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.NightSharperSen: At night zombies see and hear farther, and a lit flashlight outdoors draws zombies from afar.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.NightHunt_toolt: At night, every so often, zombies near each player go to them even without seeing them.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.NightSpeedMult_: Game speed comes in steps (shambler, fast shambler, sprinter): 1.0 keeps it, 1.5 raises one step, 2.5 raises two.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.NightSenseMult_: Sight and hearing come in steps: 1.0 keeps them, 1.5 raises one, 2.5 raises two. Also multiplies the flashlight range (20 tiles x value).
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.HuntIntervalMin: How often, at night, zombies are called to each player.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.HuntRadius_tool: Distance from the player within which zombies hear the hunt call.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.EstaladorEnable: In fog, day or night, some zombies become Clickers: blind, guided only by sound, clicking every so often. Crouched and silent, you can walk right past them.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.CorredorEnabled: In fog, day or night, some zombies become Runners: they sprint and, when they see a player, scream and call the zombies around.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.EstaladorChance: Percentage of zombies that become Clickers in each fog. All fog monsters share one roll: if the chances add up to more than 100, the ones after Clickers get less.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.CorredorChance_: Percentage of zombies that become Runners in each fog. Same roll as Clickers, Faceless and Mourners: above 100 in total, the ones after Runners get less.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.CorredorScreamR: Distance within which zombies hear the Runner scream and go to it.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.SemRostoEnabled: In fog some zombies become Faceless: look at one (or shine a light on it) and it vanishes, only to reappear closer, out of your sight. The radio hisses in your head when one is near.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.SemRostoChance_: Percentage of zombies that become Faceless in each fog. Same roll as Clickers and Runners, after them: above 100 in total, Faceless (and Mourners, who come after) get only what is left.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.CarpideiraEnabl: In fog some zombies become Mourners: they stand still, sobbing quietly. Get close, point a flashlight at one or make a loud noise nearby and it lets out a scream that calls zombies from far away, then runs after whoever woke it. One scream per fog.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.CarpideiraChanc: Percentage of zombies that become Mourners in each fog. Same roll as the other monsters, after all of them: above 100 in total, Mourners get only what is left.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.CarpideiraTrigg: A player this close wakes the Mourner, even crouched. A flashlight pointed at it or a loud noise (a gunshot) wakes it from up to 10 tiles.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.CarpideiraScrea: How far zombies hear the Mourner scream and come to it.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.FogAmbience_too: In fog a low drone and distant metallic noises replace the ambience. Only on your game.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.FogOverlays: Fog: blood and decay on floors and walls
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.FogOverlays_too: In fog, the world around you turns into the Otherworld: pools and trails of blood, grime and cracks on floors and walls, burnt floors indoors, weeds and vines outdoors, heavier in red fog. Only you see them; they vanish when the fog lifts and nothing stays on the map or in the save. Each player sets the amount in Options > Mods.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.FogVignette_too: In fog the screen edges darken and blur. It steps aside while you forage.
Sandbox_NevoaEOutroMundo.FogVignetteInte: 0 disables the effect, 1 is default, 2 is double.
